scope: Overnight public ocean, river and expedition cruise candidates. Excludes charter-only and day-trip-only vessels; charter availability alone does not exclude a ship sold on public overnight cruises.

deduplication.method: Case-folded Unicode names; normalize punctuation/whitespace for exact-name comparison. Do not strip brand prefixes or roman numerals. Check exact names against batch001. No fuzzy physical-identity merges.
deduplication.requires_before_catalog: Verify IMO/ENI or another authoritative permanent identity, former names/operator history, actual operator relationship, current service status and public overnight eligibility. Resolve cross-marketing before assigning UUIDs.

exclusions.reason: Zodiacs, Xplorer tenders and similar shore boats are not overnight cruise ship leads.

Not in task scope; no known charter-only/day-trip-only vessel retained.
